text: The Patriots head into their Week 8 matchup against the Dolphins dealing with significant injury concerns on the offensive side of the ball, with wide receiver A.J. Brown listed as questionable after missing the final two practices with both ankle and knee issues—a new knee ailment that surfaced even after his recent return from injured reserve. On the brighter side, the Patriots' secondary appears to be healthy and ready for the challenge ahead, while quarterback Drake Maye continues to lead all NFL quarterbacks in passing yards on scramble drills, a dimension that could prove valuable in Miami. The Dolphins, meanwhile, are looking to build momentum against the defending AFC champion Patriots in what will be largely unfamiliar territory for most of their roster, adding intrigue to a matchup where the Patriots' ability to generate big plays outside the structure of traditional plays may be crucial if their receiving options remain compromised.
